en.headline: Seasonal flu vaccination programmes start on 17 September
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said about 1.3 million doses have been procured for the 2026/27 programmes, with school outreach, residential care and subsidy schemes opening mid-month.
body: The Centre for Health Protection of the Department of Health announced on Monday that the 2026/27 Seasonal Influenza Vaccination Programmes will commence on 17 September. Eligible persons can receive free or subsidised vaccines through the school outreach programme, residential care home programme and Vaccination Subsidy Scheme.

Controller Dr Edwin Tsui said about 1.3 million doses had been procured from two licensed wholesalers, covering inactivated, nasal spray and recombinant vaccines. Hong Kong entered the influenza season in late June and activity remains high, with 11 severe paediatric cases recorded so far, including one death.

Data from last season showed unvaccinated children faced about five times the risk of severe complications compared with vaccinated children, while the figure was about four times higher among unvaccinated elderly residents of care homes. The centre urged the public, especially target groups, to get vaccinated early as the new school year begins.
Enhancements this year include wider use of eHealth electronic consent forms and expanded community outreach through District Councils and Care Teams.

zh.headline: 2026/27季節性流感疫苗接種計劃9月17日展開
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心公布計劃包括學校外展、院舍及疫苗資助計劃，已採購約130萬劑疫苗，呼籲市民盡早接種。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心周一公布，2026/27年度季節性流感疫苗接種計劃將於9月17日展開，包括學校外展計劃、院舍防疫注射計劃及疫苗資助計劃，合資格人士可獲免費或資助接種。
總監徐樂堅表示，本年度共採購約130萬劑疫苗，由兩間持牌藥物批發商中標，涵蓋注射式滅活、噴鼻式減活及注射式重組流感疫苗。本港自6月底進入流感季節，活動水平仍然偏高，已錄11宗兒童嚴重個案，包括一宗死亡。
上季數據顯示，未接種疫苗的兒童出現嚴重併發症的比率約為已接種兒童的五倍，65歲或以上安老院舍未接種長者則約為四倍。中心呼籲市民尤其高危群組在新學年開始後盡早接種。
本年度優化措施包括擴大醫健通電子同意書應用，以及透過區議會及關愛隊加強社區外展。
